name: Trust Fintech Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1998, Trust Fintech Ltd is in the business of selling software and allied services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
TFL is a CMMI Level 5, ISO 9001:2015, and ISO 27001:2013 certified company specializing in software solutions and services. Its offerings cover sectors including banking, ERP implementation, customized software development, SAP B1, and offshore IT services.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.00 times its book value
cons: Earnings include an other income of Rs.4.07 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 177 days.
Working capital days have increased from 119 days to 182 days
